outgoing.explanation: The manuscript grant-on-condition and the 26 December 1659 surrender via Daniel Shed are the direct evidence that John took up and gave back the Billerica lot.

sources.excerpt: Daniel Shead in answer for his father John Gurney; the said John Gurney surrendred up the Lott
sources.locator: Billerica town records 1653-1727 (MS), DGS 007466228, image 173 (grant/surrender); image 15 (re-grant to John Hall, 19 March 1659/60); images 179-180 (great-meadow lots)

statement: The Billerica manuscript town book records a ten-acre house-lot granted to John Gurney 15 August 1659 'upon condition' he inhabit it himself (his son Richard accepted as a fellow inhabitant), and on 26 December 1659 its surrender: 'Daniel Shead in answer for his father John Gurney; the said John Gurney surrendred up the Lott.'
